title: Quoted-CSV Row Scanner
prompt:
Implement `static List<String> parseRow(String line)` — a character
scanner that:
- splits on commas OUTSIDE double quotes
- treats `""` inside a quoted field as a literal `"`
- keeps quoted commas in the field (`"a,b"` → one field `a,b`)
- returns empty field list entries for consecutive commas
(`a,,b` → [a, , b])

The tests hit every rule from the lesson.

tests.name: quoted comma stays one field
tests.hint: The quoted comma must not split.

tests.name: empty fields preserved
tests.hint: Consecutive commas produce an empty field.
